1.why: Source P1: reach the ridge at low 5th class and build a belay there; matches stored 4th/5th ridge belay.
1.text: Stop once the pitch reaches the crest of the ridge, and set up the belay there.

2.why: Source P2: traverse sharp ridge from first gendarme to its end, downclimb into notch and anchor. Corrected: 'past' removed.
2.text: After traversing the sharp ridge from the first gendarme, downclimb into the notch at its far end and anchor there.

3.why: Source P3: go right around second gendarme, straight up to ridge, belay from large slung boulder. Corrected: 'angle' to 'straight'.
3.text: Go around the second gendarme on its right, then climb straight up to the ridge, where a big slung boulder serves as the belay.

4.why: Source P4: knife-edge, downclimb notch, belay from large boulder around the corner with cordelette.
4.text: The belay is at a large boulder around the corner from the notch past the knife-edge, backed by a cordelette looped around it.

5.why: Source P5: long class 3 traverse to base of final rock pitch, belay from a sling there.
5.text: Belay from a sling at the foot of the final vertical rock, at the end of the long exposed walking traverse.
